description: This file defines a PHP class LeaveRequestModel that represents the data model for leave requests in the OrangeHRM leave plugin API. It uses traits for serialization, implements a constructor to set entity filters and attribute mappings, and includes OpenAPI annotations for API schema documentation.

classes.name: LeaveRequestModel
classes.description: A model class representing a leave request, used for API responses, with description annotations for schema generation.
